descriptions.en: A compact macOS status dashboard for the NotchAny tray. Monitor CPU and memory usage, battery charge state, health, cycles and temperature, system disk capacity and read/write throughput, plus network upload/download rates and Wi-Fi or wired connectivity.
descriptions.zh-Hans: 适用于 NotchAny 托盘的紧凑型 macOS 状态面板。实时监控 CPU 与内存占用、电池充放电状态、健康度、循环次数和温度、系统盘容量与读写速度，以及网络上下行和 Wi-Fi/有线连接。

summaries.en: Live CPU, memory, battery, disk, and network status at a glance.
summaries.zh-Hans: 一眼查看 CPU、内存、电池、磁盘与网络实时状态。
